notes: §2002:12.3.4.3 GR1 lists a)-m) the agreement items for entries referencing one external connector; h) requires the same PADDING CHARACTER specification with data-name-8 external, and the 2002 list has no FILE STATUS item. §2002:13.16.20.3 GR2 a) makes both FDs one external connector. Two programs with agreeing entries (OPTIONAL, sequential, RESERVE 2, PADDING CHARACTER IS external EXT-PAD) and different local FILE STATUS items conform, so the run unit is accepted and shares one connector: P1 OPEN 00, P1 WRITE 00, P2 WRITE 00 (on P1's open connector), P2 CLOSE 00, P1 OPEN 00, READ 00 AAAA, R... run at --std 2002 on the pinned build: exit 0, 8 lines equal the derived .out (MATCH); COBOL0903 obsolete warning for PADDING CHARACTER only. The same source at --std 2023 is refused (COBOL0902 PADDING removed, COBOL1624 FILE STATUS not external), as the 2023 list's i) requires.
